title: Cut the Core packages the program never reaches and give MCP tools a registration seam
goal: CEO 2026-11-22: lay the ecosystem foundation right - bloat free, dynamic, zero config, extensible, lean, fast, performant - before features. Core's program reaches only susi-gmcp, susi-paths, serde_json and sha2; susi-core, susi-abi, susi-gawd-acp and susi-gawd-a2a (5.4k lines) are reached by nothing but their own tests.

reuse.searched: Core and Susi: the seam for host tools reuses the MCP server already in susi-gmcp (server.rs, tools.rs) instead of the plane bus of susi-core; nothing new is built beyond a trait and a list. The packages removed have no user in Core's program, its tests or Susi's manifest (which names susi-config, susi-error, susi-paths and the getrandom, serde, serde_json and sha2 facades only)
